name: BH1745 RGB Color Sensor
description: The `bh1745` component allows you to use your BH1745 (BH1745NUC) RGB color sensor ([datasheet](https://github.com/latonita/datasheets-storage/blob/main/sensors/BH1745NUC_ROHM_S_A0001988929_1-2561519.pdf), [Pimoroni](https://shop.pimoroni.com/products/bh1745-luminance-and-colour-sensor-breakout)) with ESPHome. It reports the red, green, blue and clear channel readings and calculates the illuminance and the color temperature of the light.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: Manually specify the I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x38`.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: The interval to read the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for this hub. Use this if you want to use more than one BH1745 sensor.

config_entries.label: Gain
config_entries.description: The gain of the internal ADC. Higher values work better in low light. One of `1X`, `2X` or `16X`. Defaults to `1X`.

config_entries.label: Glass Attenuation Factor
config_entries.description: Use this when the sensor sits behind glass or another cover that blocks some of the light. The illuminance is multiplied by this value to make up for the lost light: `1.0` means all light passes through, `2.0` means half of it does. Must be at least `1.0`. Defaults to `1.0`.

config_entries.label: Integration Time
config_entries.description: How long the sensor collects light for each measurement. Longer times work better in low light. One of `160ms`, `320ms`, `640ms`, `1280ms`, `2560ms` or `5120ms`. Defaults to `160ms`.
